tasks.name: Prepare block plot plan options
tasks.description: Lays out alternative block plot arrangements for the unit, offsites and tankage on the candidate site for configuration screening.

consumes.use: process blocks, main streams, capacities and tankage/utility blocks per option
site boundary, survey benchmarks, prevailing wind and site access rules
existing facility layout, existing interconnecting piping and utility tie points
owner layout and spacing standards
preliminary worst-case hazard zones and receptor distances per site
recommended block spacing, sterile areas and building locations
topography, flood elevation and access routes per candidate site
existing ground levels, plant grid, existing roads and underground services

tasks.name: Estimate piping quantities for FEL1 estimate
tasks.description: Factors piping tonnage, bulk quantities and interconnecting run lengths per option for the Class 5 estimate.

consumes.use: block footprints, rack corridor length and interconnecting run lengths per option
equipment type, count, key size and material class per option
quantity take-off template, estimate class, code of accounts and due date

tasks.name: Write piping layout design basis
tasks.description: Sets the layout, spacing, access, maintenance, rack and model rules (elevations, clearances, valve access, naming) for the project.

consumes.use: owner piping and layout standards, order of precedence
operating access, isolation, drains, bundle pull and lifting requirements
spacing codes, fire-fighting access and design fire basis
recommended equipment spacing and sterile areas
design life, units, winterisation and site design margins
climatic design data and seismic zone
access widths, crane corridors and module transport limits

tasks.name: Develop plot plan and equipment layout
tasks.description: Develops the selected plot plan with equipment locations, rack corridors, roads and maintenance areas and issues it for review and HAZOP.

consumes.use: equipment tag, type, size and operating/design P/T
equipment interconnections from IFR P&IDs
minimum elevations for NPSH, thermosiphon and gravity drain, close-coupling and adjacency
overall dimensions, support type and location
footprint, height, bundle pull, internals removal and crane access envelopes
equipment tag list with size and operating weight
hazard distances, spacing changes and marked-up plot plan
building acceptability, relocation and occupancy restrictions
flare sterile zone radius and radiation contours at grade
plant coordinate system, benchmarks, existing ground levels and grid
spacing tables, access and maintenance rules
substation and electrical building footprint and clearances
control and rack room footprint and cabinet space
road widths, drainage falls, dike footprints and foundation interference markups

tasks.name: Build 3D layout model
tasks.description: Builds the early S3D model with equipment envelopes, structures, rack and access space for layout reviews.

consumes.use: equipment locations, rack corridors and roads
equipment coordinates, elevations and orientation
outline dimensions, skirt/saddle heights and nozzle positions
preliminary nozzle schedule sizes and ratings
rack widths, bent spacing, tier elevations and structure frame sizes

tasks.name: Lay out pipe racks and assign tiers
tasks.description: Sizes main pipe rack widths and tiers, allocates lines and cable tray space, and estimates rack loads for civil.

consumes.use: line number, from/to, fluid, design P/T and insulation for rack lines
line sizes for rack lines
from/to of interconnecting lines
electrical tray widths and rack levels reserved
instrument cable count and tray loading per segment
rack corridors and road crossings
uniform tier load and anchor/guide load limits assumed by civil

tasks.name: Study critical line routing
tasks.description: Routes large-bore, alloy, two-phase, transfer and pump suction lines in the model to confirm layout and early stress feasibility.

consumes.use: slope, no-pocket, gravity, NPSH and symmetrical routing requirements
critical-line flags, two-phase flow regime and line sizes
IFR P&IDs for routed systems
nozzle schedule sizes, ratings and duties on columns and vessels
preliminary nozzle positions on heaters, pumps and exchangers

tasks.name: Request equipment nozzle orientations and elevations
tasks.description: Defines required nozzle orientations, elevations, platform and davit positions from routing and returns them to mechanical and vendors.

consumes.use: nozzle positions and support details
nozzle schedule
engineering nozzle angles, elevations, platform clips and davits to comment
package, pump, compressor and exchanger nozzle sizes and orientations
critical line routing and required nozzle positions

tasks.name: Develop piping material classes
tasks.description: Writes piping classes by service with pressure-temperature ratings, components, branch tables and wall thickness calculations.

consumes.use: base material, corrosion allowance, sour/NACE, PWHT and impact test per circuit
max design P/T and MDMT per system
fluid code and design P/T per line group
owner piping material standards and approved vendors

tasks.name: Build S3D piping specification catalogue
tasks.description: Loads piping classes, commodity codes and valve codes into the S3D catalogue for routing, isometrics and MTO.

consumes.use: class rules, components by size, wall thickness, branch tables, valve codes
valve and component outline dimensions and weights from preferred vendor offers

tasks.name: Prepare valve specifications and datasheets
tasks.description: Writes valve datasheets by valve code covering type, rating, materials, trim, end connection and testing.

consumes.use: valve codes per class with rating and materials
isolation and blinding philosophy, tight shut-off and special service needs
actuated on/off valve type, size, rating, shut-off class and fire-proofing

tasks.name: Prepare specialty item list and datasheets
tasks.description: Lists and specifies special piping items (strainers, spectacle blinds, hoses, sight glasses, expansion joints, steam traps).

consumes.use: SP item tags, sizes, line numbers and service on IFD P&IDs
flow, operating/design P/T and fluid per SP item line
class rating and materials for SP items

tasks.name: Prepare piping fabrication, erection and inspection specifications
tasks.description: Specifies fabrication, welding, NDE extent, PWHT, testing, cleaning and painting requirements for shop and field piping.

consumes.use: owner welding, NDE, painting and insulation standards
PWHT, hardness, sour service and impact test requirements
shop versus field fabrication split and module scope
preferred spool sizes and shop vs field work preferences

tasks.name: Add piping data to the line list
tasks.description: Adds piping class, test pressure and medium, NDE category, PWHT, paint and insulation systems to each line in the line list.

consumes.use: line number, fluid, operating/design P/T, test pressure basis, insulation and tracing requirement
class assignment by service and P/T
NDE category, PWHT and test rules

tasks.name: Prepare FEL3 piping MTO for the estimate
tasks.description: Combines model-based quantities for routed areas with factored quantities for the rest into a bulk piping MTO for the estimate and early buys.

consumes.use: model quantities in routed areas
rack and corridor lengths for factored areas
class components and materials for pricing
line sizes
line count per P&ID and fluid
estimate class, basis, growth and allowance and code of accounts

tasks.name: Route piping in the 3D model
tasks.description: Routes all lines to the P&IDs in S3D using the piping catalogue, placing valves, SP items and in-line instruments.

consumes.use: IFD P&IDs: line numbers, sizes, specs, valves, SP items, in-line instrument tags
design P/T, fluid, insulation and critical-line flags
nozzle size, rating, facing and location
certified nozzle locations, sizes and ratings for final routing
certified package GA and terminal point nozzle data
steel and concrete geometry, platforms and rack steel as S3D reference
control and on/off valve face-to-face, weights and actuator envelopes
flow element sizes and upstream/downstream straight runs
certified face-to-face and weights for model update
tray and conduit routes, elevations and reserved rack levels
spec rules, commodity codes and dimensional tables

tasks.name: Check model against P&IDs
tasks.description: Runs the SPID to S3D correlation through SPF and resolves differences in line numbers, sizes, specs and components.

consumes.use: P&ID lines, valves, SP items and instruments published from SPID
line number, size and spec attributes for correlation
modelled lines and components

tasks.name: Position in-line instruments and instrument access
tasks.description: Places in-line and line-mounted instruments with straight runs, orientation and access, and issues positions to I&C.

consumes.use: tag, type, line number and P&ID
straight-run requirements
connection type, size, orientation and elevation
routed lines for instrument placement

tasks.name: Issue as-routed line data for hydraulic checks
tasks.description: Extracts as-routed lengths, fittings and elevations for PSV inlet/outlet, pump suction and two-phase lines to process for hydraulic verification.

consumes.use: critical lines requiring hydraulic verification (gravity, two-phase, pump suction)
PSV tags, inlet/outlet sizes and allowable back pressure for inlet loss and tailpipe checks
as-routed geometry

tasks.name: Prepare stress-critical line list
tasks.description: Categorises lines for stress analysis by size, temperature, service and connected equipment.

consumes.use: design and minimum design temperatures, steam-out and vacuum conditions
upset and start-up cases governing temperatures
operating and design temperature per line
class, size and insulation per line
equipment type: rotating, air coolers, heaters

tasks.name: Perform screening stress analysis
tasks.description: Runs simplified and screening analyses on critical lines to confirm loops, layout and anchor concepts.

consumes.use: critical line geometry exported to CAESAR II
lines and load cases to screen
preliminary allowable forces and moments per nozzle

tasks.name: Perform detailed stress analysis in CAESAR II
tasks.description: Analyses stress-critical lines exported from S3D for sustained, thermal, occasional and test cases and sets supports.

consumes.use: stress line geometry exported from S3D
stress category, load cases and temperatures
design and upset temperatures and pressures
operating cases for load case definition
relief load, set pressure and fluid for PSV reaction forces
two-phase flow regime and slug flags
allowable nozzle forces and moments
certified nozzle locations for anchor points
vendor allowable nozzle loads
certified nozzle data for rotating equipment and packages
wind speed and exposure, seismic parameters
structure deflection limits and rack load allowance assumptions

tasks.name: Resolve nozzle loads with mechanical and vendors
tasks.description: Agrees exceeded nozzle loads with mechanical and vendors by re-routing, re-supporting or vendor acceptance.

consumes.use: calculated nozzle loads vs allowables
acceptance or required piping changes per nozzle
vendor responses accepting or rejecting exceeded nozzle loads

tasks.name: Specify and requisition spring and engineered supports
tasks.description: Prepares the spring hanger and engineered support datasheet and requisition and reviews vendor data.

consumes.use: spring loads, travel and support type
spring and engineered support drawings and load tables
approved bidders for spring supports
MR number and need date

tasks.name: Design pipe supports
tasks.description: Places standard and special supports in S3D and details special supports, trunnions and secondary steel requirements.

consumes.use: support type changes, guides, anchors and spring locations
support loads for support selection
routed lines
available steel members and platforms
owner standard pipe support catalogue and standards

tasks.name: Request civil and structural openings, platforms and foundations
tasks.description: Issues piping requirements for platforms, access, sleepers, trenches, culverts, wall and floor penetrations to civil.

consumes.use: routing, valve and instrument access points
structure layout
foundation locations and top of concrete

tasks.name: Design underground piping
tasks.description: Lays out underground firewater, oily water and process drains and buried lines and coordinates with civil drainage and foundations.

consumes.use: ring main sizing basis, hydrant and monitor locations, isolation valve sectioning
finished grade elevations
sewer routes, inverts, catch basins and manholes
foundation outlines and depths
road crossings
underground composite: crossings and depths
drain system P&IDs
effluent and drain flows and composition
duct bank routes, depths and crossings
ground grid routing

tasks.name: Run 30/60/90 model reviews
tasks.description: Prepares model review packages and runs reviews with operations, safety, construction and all disciplines, tracking actions to close.

consumes.use: routed piping
supports
Tekla structural model published to Navisworks
owner access, valve reach and maintenance comments
spacing, escape, fire-fighting access and valve operability comments
safety shower, escape route and muster locations
access, rigging, scaffolding and spool break comments
electrical tray and equipment in model
instrument and JB locations
JB coordinates and sizes
instrument access and valve orientation comments
slope, pocket, NPSH, two-phase and PSV location comments
equipment access, removal clearance and nozzle discrepancy comments

tasks.name: Detect and resolve clashes
tasks.description: Runs interference checks across piping, structural, electrical and instrument models and resolves hard and soft clashes.

consumes.use: routed piping for interference checks
structural reference geometry
tray and conduit routes
instrument locations and tray routing
JB positions and sizes
civil resolution and model change status per clash

tasks.name: Respond to HAZOP and safety layout actions
tasks.description: Implements and closes HAZOP, siting and fire and gas actions that need layout or piping changes.

consumes.use: HAZOP recommendations assigned to piping
preliminary HAZOP layout and isolation actions
HAZID layout actions
QRA spacing and isolation recommendations
clouded HAZOP P&ID changes
updated IFD P&IDs

tasks.name: Incorporate vendor data and manage piping holds
tasks.description: Updates the model with certified vendor nozzle and package data and maintains the piping hold list.

consumes.use: certified GA nozzle locations, sizes, ratings and terminal points
certified equipment nozzle data for model update
consolidated vendor document review codes
hold status per requisition and vendor document
P&ID hold answers and release dates

tasks.name: Extract and check isometrics
tasks.description: Extracts isometrics from S3D, checks them and issues IFC isometrics with bill of materials and weld data.

consumes.use: routed lines
supports
stress sign-off per stress system
released holds
test pressure, NDE, PWHT, paint and insulation per line
document numbering, revision and issue-purpose conventions
reserved isometric document numbers

tasks.name: Prepare spool lists and fabrication packages
tasks.description: Splits isometrics into shop spools and field welds and issues spool lists and fabrication packages to the fabricator.

consumes.use: IFC isometrics with welds and BOM
module boundaries and maximum dimensions
preferred spool sizes and field weld preferences

tasks.name: Produce MTO by ident and bulk requisitions
tasks.description: Exports MTO by commodity ident from S3D, applies surplus and reconciles against prior buys, and issues bulk requisitions.

consumes.use: model quantities
isometric BOM by ident
valve datasheets
SP item list
previous PO line quantities by commodity code
previous bulk MR lines with surplus
ROS dates by CWP for delivery split

tasks.name: Evaluate piping bids
tasks.description: Evaluates technical offers for bulk piping, valves and specialty items against requisitions.

consumes.use: technical portions of bids
technical clarification answers
requisition technical requirements

tasks.name: Review valve and specialty item vendor data
tasks.description: Reviews vendor drawings, test certificates and data books for valves and specialty items.

consumes.use: valve and SP item drawings and dimensions
MTRs per component
hydrotest, NDE and fire-safe test certificates
vendor documents routed for review with return date

tasks.name: Produce piping GA and key plan drawings
tasks.description: Extracts piping general arrangement drawings, sections and key plans from S3D for construction and review.

consumes.use: routed piping
plant grid references
structural references

tasks.name: Identify tie-ins and issue tie-in packages
tasks.description: Surveys existing connections, lists tie-ins with type and timing, and issues tie-in sketches and packages.

consumes.use: fluid, operating/design P/T, hot-tap feasibility and isolation/purging per tie-in; hot tap and isolation requirements (taken from process tie-in conditions)
tie-in points on P&IDs
existing facility as-built drawings and line data
outage windows and tie-ins allowed per window

tasks.name: Define hydrotest and test pack boundaries
tasks.description: Defines test circuits by test pressure and medium aligned to systems and issues test pack boundaries.

consumes.use: isometrics for circuit definition
test pressure and medium per line
system and subsystem limits and isolation points
subsystem numbers and descriptions
equipment hydrotest pressure and MAWP
equipment design P/T to include or isolate
in-line instrument types to remove or isolate

tasks.name: Issue model to AWP and construction model
tasks.description: Publishes the piping model through Navisworks to iConstruct with iso, spool and CWP attributes for work packaging.

consumes.use: piping model
iso attributes
spool attributes
CWA boundaries
CWP IDs and scope boundaries
area sequence

tasks.name: Review fabricator spool drawings
tasks.description: Reviews fabricator spool drawings and weld maps against IFC isometrics.

consumes.use: fabricator weld maps and NDE records

tasks.name: Respond to piping RFIs and field changes
tasks.description: Answers site RFIs and issues field change isos and model updates for piping.

consumes.use: RFI question, location and markups
proposed field change, markups and affected drawings
material availability per IWP
material shortages per IWP
commissioning queries on piping

tasks.name: Reconcile piping material shortages and surplus
tasks.description: Reconciles MTO with received and issued materials and raises supplementary requisitions for shortages.

consumes.use: ordered vs received vs issued by commodity
received quantities
issued quantities
required quantities by ident
work-face shortages and damage

tasks.name: Prepare as-built isometrics and model
tasks.description: Incorporates field redlines into isometrics and the model and issues as-built records for handover.

consumes.use: redlined isometrics and layout drawings
field change isos
test pack status
punch items affecting piping
final weld numbers and NDE/PWHT records

items.name: Block plot plan options
items.content: Block-level arrangement per option: block footprints, main rack corridor, tank farm, flare location, roads, approximate areas and interconnecting run lengths.

items.name: FEL1 factored piping quantities
items.content: Per option: piping weight factors per equipment, interconnecting pipe length by size range, rack length, alloy fraction.

items.name: Piping layout design basis
items.content: Spacing tables, clearances and headroom, rack elevations and tier allocation rules, valve and instrument access rules, platform rules, S3D modelling and naming conventions.

items.name: Plot plan
items.content: Equipment locations to grid, rack corridors, roads, buildings, lay-down and maintenance areas, north arrow, battery limits, area numbering.

items.name: Equipment location list
items.content: Per equipment tag: coordinates (E/N), foundation top/grade elevation, orientation, support type (grade, structure, rack); used by civil foundations and mechanical.

items.name: 3D layout model
items.content: Equipment envelopes, structures and rack placeholders, access and maintenance volumes, main line corridors for layout review.

items.name: Pipe rack layout and widths
items.content: Rack routes, widths, bay spacing, tier elevations, line allocation by tier, cable tray levels, future space allowance, road crossing clearances.

items.name: Pipe rack preliminary loads
items.content: Per rack bay and tier: uniform pipe load (operating, hydrotest), concentrated anchor/guide loads, friction allowance, future load allowance.

items.name: Critical line routing studies
items.content: Routing of critical lines with stress loop concepts, elevations and space claims; flags equipment relocation needs.

items.name: Nozzle orientation and elevation requests
items.content: Per equipment: nozzle orientation angles, elevations, projections, platform, ladder and davit locations, clip locations for pipe supports.

items.name: Piping material class specification
items.content: Per class: rating, P-T limits, materials, corrosion allowance, wall thickness by size, components by size range, gaskets and bolting, branch table, valve codes.

items.name: S3D piping spec and commodity catalogue
items.content: Spec rules, short codes, commodity codes (idents), dimensional tables, valve operators, branch rules used by routing and isometric extraction.

items.name: Valve datasheets
items.content: Per valve code: type, rating, body/trim/seat materials, ends, operator, fire-safe and fugitive emission tests, NDE and inspection.

items.name: Specialty piping item list and datasheets
items.content: Per SP tag: type, size, rating, materials, P&ID and line number, process data, quantity, datasheet reference.

items.name: Piping fabrication, erection and inspection specification
items.content: Welding and WPS requirements, NDE class by line category, PWHT rules, hydrotest and pneumatic test rules, flushing and cleaning, painting and insulation reference.

items.name: Line list piping attributes
items.content: Per line: piping class, test pressure, test medium, NDE category, PWHT, paint system, insulation type and thickness, stress category.

items.name: Estimate piping bulk MTO
items.content: Pipe length, fittings, flanges, valves and SP items by class, size and material; field and shop weld counts; growth allowances by area.

items.name: Routed piping model
items.content: Lines by number with class, size, components, valves, SP items, in-line instruments, supports placeholders and insulation; source for isos, MTO, reviews and clash checks.

items.name: P&ID to model consistency report
items.content: Mismatches between P&ID and model: missing or extra lines, size, spec and component differences, tag mismatches, with resolution status.

items.name: In-line instrument positions
items.content: Per instrument tag: line number, coordinates, elevation, orientation, upstream/downstream straight run, access platform, tapping orientation; used for instrument hook-ups and cable routing.

items.name: As-routed line hydraulic data
items.content: Per line: equivalent length, fittings count, elevation changes, pockets, PSV inlet/outlet routing and tailpipe geometry.

items.name: Stress-critical line list
items.content: Per line: stress category (visual, simplified, CAESAR II), load cases, governing temperatures, connected sensitive equipment, analysis owner and status.

items.name: Screening stress results and layout markups
items.content: Expansion loop and anchor concepts, routing changes, equipment location requests, spring support needs for critical lines.

items.name: Stress calculation report
items.content: CAESAR II models and report per stress system: load cases, code compliance, displacements, flange leakage checks, support types and locations.

items.name: Nozzle loads for equipment
items.content: Per equipment nozzle: forces and moments by load case compared to allowables; sent to mechanical and vendors for acceptance.

items.name: Support loads for civil and structural
items.content: Per support tag: location, support type, operating, sustained, hydrotest, wind and seismic loads, friction loads, for steel and foundation design.

items.name: Stress markups to the model
items.content: Routing changes, support type changes, gaps, guides, anchors and spring locations to be applied in S3D by layout designers.

items.name: Nozzle load acceptance
items.content: Per nozzle: accepted, rerouted or reinforced; vendor and mechanical sign-off reference.

items.name: Spring and engineered support requisition
items.content: Per support tag: hot/cold load, travel, type, size, materials, coating, quantities; technical requisition and TBE.

items.name: Pipe support model and special support drawings
items.content: Supports in S3D by tag and standard type; special support details; support MTO for steel and attachments.

items.name: Secondary steel and support steel requests
items.content: Required secondary steel, stub columns, extra beams, sleeper locations and support attachment points with loads; sent to civil/structural.

items.name: Platform, access and penetration requests
items.content: Platform and ladder locations for valve and instrument access, sleeper and pipe-track positions, trench and culvert crossings, sleeves and wall openings with sizes.

items.name: Underground piping layout
items.content: Underground line routes, inverts, cover depths, crossings, manholes, catch basins and tie points; coordinated with civil drainage.

items.name: Model review package
items.content: Navisworks review model with checklists by area, review scope, attendee list, previous action status.

items.name: Model review action list
items.content: Per action: area, location, description, responsible discipline, due date, close-out evidence.

items.name: Clash report
items.content: Per clash: objects, disciplines, location, type (hard/soft/clearance), owner, resolution and status.

items.name: Piping safety action responses
items.content: Per action: response, model/drawing changes made, evidence, close-out status.

items.name: Piping vendor data review comments
items.content: Piping comments on vendor GAs and interface drawings: nozzle orientation, connection type, support clips, access.

items.name: Piping hold list
items.content: Per hold: line or iso, reason (vendor data, P&ID, stress), owner, due date, released status.

items.name: IFC isometrics
items.content: Per line/sheet: geometry, coordinates, BOM by ident, weld numbers, shop/field welds, supports, NDE, PWHT, test data, revision clouds.

items.name: Spool list and fabrication package
items.content: Per spool: spool ID, iso, size, class, weight, welds, NDE, PWHT, paint, bill of materials; fabrication package release.

items.name: Piping MTO by ident
items.content: Per commodity ident: description, class, size, schedule, material, quantity by area and iso, surplus, delta to previous MTO; exported to Purchasing DB.

items.name: Piping bulk material requisitions
items.content: Requisitions for pipe, fittings, flanges, gaskets, bolting, valves and SP items with technical specs, quantities and delivery split.

items.name: Piping technical bid evaluation
items.content: Per bidder and line item: compliance, deviations, clarifications, technical recommendation.

items.name: Valve and SP item vendor data review
items.content: Return codes and comments; certified dimensions to be updated in the S3D catalogue.

items.name: Piping GA drawings and key plans
items.content: Plans and sections by area with line numbers, elevations, equipment and structural references, match lines, area key plan.

items.name: Tie-in list
items.content: Per tie-in: number, P&ID, existing and new line numbers, size, class, type (hot tap, cold cut, flanged), shutdown requirement, status.

items.name: Tie-in packages
items.content: Per tie-in: sketch, isometric, survey photos, materials, isolation and method, NDE and test requirements.

items.name: Test pack boundaries
items.content: Marked-up P&IDs and isos for each test circuit: limits, blinds, vents and drains, test pressure and medium, gauge location.

items.name: Test pack register
items.content: Per test pack: number, system/subsystem, lines and isos included, test pressure and medium; loaded to Smart Completions for ITR tracking.

items.name: Piping construction model export
items.content: Navisworks piping model with line, iso, spool, test pack and CWP attributes for AWP and material availability.

items.name: Spool drawing review comments
items.content: Return codes and comments per spool drawing against IFC iso.

items.name: Piping RFI responses
items.content: Per RFI: answer, sketch or markup, affected isos and lines, cost/schedule impact flag.

items.name: Field change isometrics
items.content: Revised isometrics and model updates issued for field changes with revision clouds and material changes.

items.name: Piping material shortage and surplus list
items.content: Per ident: required, received, issued, shortage, surplus, supplementary requisition reference.

items.name: As-built isometrics
items.content: As-built isometrics with final routing, welds and supports, issued for handover.

items.name: As-built piping model
items.content: S3D model updated to as-built for operations handover.

gaps.info: Project specification and code list (ASME B31.3 edition, referenced standards, order of precedence for piping)
Equipment thermal growth and nozzle displacements (columns, heaters, exchangers) and nozzle flexibility data for CAESAR II
Bulk material surplus and allowance policy (percent by commodity and size)
Field verification survey of existing tie-in points (dimensions, wall thickness, condition, photos)
Fabricator spool shop drawings for review against IFC isometrics
